name: disprove-lock-in-caller
description: One claim says Counter.bump is an unsynchronised read-modify-write, but its only caller holds a lock; the other is a real divide-by-zero when no reading is ok

findings.body: `bump` does an unsynchronised `self.value += 1`, a read-modify-write that loses updates when handlers run on several threads.
`report` passes `average` a list filtered to ok readings, which is empty when none are ok, so `sum(values) / len(values)` raises ZeroDivisionError.
